countSemantics.revision: Increment after accepted fixes or a material external seam changes the section under review.
countSemantics.terminal: The Luna floor is cumulative, but zero-useful confirmations count only on the current revision and only for whole-section-unrestricted reviews.

reviewModes.whole-section-unrestricted: Independent review of the complete declared section manifest and material unchanged-code/proof handoffs; counts toward floor and terminality.
reviewModes.narrow-focused: Named-lens or focused review; supplemental only and never counts toward section floor or terminality.
reviewModes.legacy-unclassified: Historical entry without reviewMode and without the explicit broad-followup label; retained for history but never treated as unrestricted evidence.

countSemantics.implementationDisposition: Track discovered/deferred implementation gaps separately from fixes admitted to the corpus PR; implementation admission is adjudicated per finding by correctness, coherence, risk, and review-focus cost.
